refresh_rationale: Extends BDD-INV-003 with GEN-014 full-cycle application scenarios graded against VAL-054 through VAL-058 evidence: in-app onboarding, evidence-only report generation, catalog curation, branded PDF rendering, rendered capture (P008), and honest degradation for blocked stores.

gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.title: Public URL produces an evidence-first Inspection Report with a one-page dashboard
gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.given: a public ecommerce URL configured in an Evaluation Manifest
gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.then: the run produces inspection-report.json/md with a dashboard covering timestamp, target, platform detection, overall status, duration, evidence quality, overall confidence, and crawl health by component
gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.evidence: Dress Up GEN-013-20260713T043845Z (100% coverage, Medium confidence) and Ridge GEN-013-20260714T121451Z (partial, Low confidence); both pass node src/evaluator/validation.mjs inspection. VAL-051, VAL-053.

gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.title: Inspection output contains observation only, never interpretation
gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.when: its language and structure are validated
gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.then: it contains no recommendations, priorities, business impact, revenue estimates, consulting language, quick wins, or executive summaries
gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.evidence: Language-boundary checks in the GEN-013 validation suite pass on all runs. VAL-051, VAL-053.
mission_links: Mission Update: Inspection Report As Primary Deliverable

gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.title: Every incomplete inspection states explicit failure reasons
gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.given: a target that blocks, rate-limits, or regulates traffic
gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.then: the report records explicit infrastructure limitations (HTTP status, endpoint, classification) and never hides them
gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.evidence: Ridge GEN-013-20260714T121451Z: partial status with six recorded infrastructure limitations and readiness not_ready, while Shopify was still detected at High confidence via canonical-host payloads. VAL-053.

gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.title: Each inspection generates reusable DS1-DS4 datasets with provenance
gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.then: DS1 canonical search, DS2 query normalization, DS3 search+facet, and DS4 advanced retrieval JSONL datasets exist with schema versions, provenance, and rows traceable to observed evidence
gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.evidence: Both pilots emit all four datasets validated by schema contracts; rows remain first-slice breadth pending real catalog/browse evidence expansion. VAL-051, VAL-053.

gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.title: Platform capability gaps are classified as platform work, not retailer findings
gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.given: an inspection blocked by a missing evaluator capability
gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.then: the gap carries a capability ID (e.g. P008) separate from ecommerce observations, and downstream surfaces show it as platform work
gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.evidence: P008 rendered capture appears in platform_capability_gaps on Ridge and Dress Up runs and in the dashboard Report Readiness panel, now linking to the capability registry record. VAL-052, VAL-053.

gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.title: An engineer can judge inspection success within two minutes
gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.when: an engineer opens the operational dashboard
gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.then: status, readiness, evidence quality, confidence, coverage, crawl health, limitations, and artifacts are visible without reading raw files
gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.evidence: Dashboard hero/metrics/readiness panels validated by npm run validate:dashboard and a live browser walkthrough. VAL-052.

gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.title: Interrupted inspections resume without repeating completed work
gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.given: a run interrupted after at least one completed plugin
gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.when: the run is resumed from its checkpoint
gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.then: the same inspection ID continues, completed plugins and cached site profiles are reused with recorded reasons, and only pending plugins execute
gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.evidence: Resume validation on GEN-013-20260713T044019Z; timeline records reused_shared_cache and reused_run_checkpoint. VAL-051.

gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.title: Inspection history supports open, compare, resume, and rerun
gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.given: multiple inspections exist in workspace history
gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.then: history rows expose id, target, timestamp, status, confidence, coverage, and readiness, with run/resume/rerun actions and a compare API
gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.evidence: Dashboard run list, action endpoints, and /api/compare validated in VAL-050 and revalidated in VAL-052/VAL-053.

gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.title: Downstream reports consume the Inspection Report instead of re-inspecting
gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.given: an executive report is requested for an inspected site
gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.when: the report is generated by the application
gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.then: it reads the Inspection Report and retained evidence without new site inspection
gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.evidence: GEN-014 executive report generator reads only the run directory, states 'No new site inspection was performed' in every report, and is validated by extended validate:dashboard assertions plus the live Pink Lily full-cycle proof. VAL-054.
mission_links: Mission Update: Local Inspection Application As Expected Deliverable

gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.title: The operator can inspect the datasets behind an evaluation in-app
gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.given: the operator reviews an inspection in the dashboard
gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.when: they open the Datasets tab or a finding's dataset link
gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.then: evaluations, targets, query packs, site profiles, platform registries, inspection history, and generated DS1-DS4 records render as searchable, field-filterable tables with per-record detail, without leaving the dashboard
gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.evidence: Dataset viewer delegated by stream_mra8o4fq_47ae08ab; validated by extended validate:dashboard assertions and a live browser walkthrough. VAL-052.
mission_links: Mission Update: Local Inspection Application As Expected Deliverable

gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.title: Inspections retain raw evidence by default (decision 1A)
gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.then: raw HTTP responses, API payloads, and cached evidence are preserved immutably per run so reports can re-render and fixes can be verified without re-inspection
gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.evidence: Run directories contain raw/http and evidence trees referenced by artifact-index.json; retention ratified as operator decision 1A on 2026-07-14.

gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.title: Broad retailer inspections are gated by capability maturity (decision 3A)
gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.given: a new target is proposed for broad (non-pilot) inspection
gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.when: the target's platform type is evaluated against the maturity threshold
gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.then: Shopify targets require Level 2 maturity and non-Shopify or heavily rendered storefronts require Level 3 (P008), with bounded pilots allowed below threshold under declared limitations
gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.defer_reason: The threshold is ratified policy (decision 3A) recorded in the validation strategy, but automated target-acceptance enforcement is not yet implemented in code.
gen13_inspection_platform_bdds.revisit_when: Before the first broad multi-retailer inspection sweep.

downstream_interpretation_bdds_carried_f.note: BDD-001 through BDD-014 from BDD-INV-002 remain valid for the interpretation layer (rubrics, findings, executive reports, scorecards, opportunity matrices, PDFs) and retain their last validated statuses. Under the GEN-013 architecture these behaviors apply to downstream consumers of Inspection Reports, not to inspection itself.
downstream_interpretation_bdds_carried_f.statuses: 13 passing as of GEN-003 through GEN-012 evidence; BDD-012 (independent evaluator calibration) remains deferred until a second evaluator and completed pilot exist.

gen14_full_cycle_bdds.title: Operator adds an ecommerce site by URL and the inspection starts from the dashboard
gen14_full_cycle_bdds.given: a Shopify store URL typed into the dashboard Add Site control
gen14_full_cycle_bdds.when: the operator clicks Add Site and Inspect
gen14_full_cycle_bdds.then: a target manifest, starter query pack, and evaluation manifest are generated and the inspection starts without leaving the app
gen14_full_cycle_bdds.evidence: Live pinklily.com onboarding through the UI; temp-root onboarding tests cover idempotency, invalid URLs, and the decision-3A maturity declaration. VAL-054.

gen14_full_cycle_bdds.title: Executive reports are generated from retained inspection evidence only
gen14_full_cycle_bdds.given: a completed or partial inspection run
gen14_full_cycle_bdds.when: the operator generates the executive report
gen14_full_cycle_bdds.then: the report reads only the run directory, states that no new site inspection was performed, and ties every claim to an evidence file
gen14_full_cycle_bdds.evidence: Generator reads only the run dir; validated assertions on provenance, explainable scores, and the no-re-inspection statement. VAL-054, VAL-056.

gen14_full_cycle_bdds.title: Query packs are curated from the store catalog without re-contacting the site
gen14_full_cycle_bdds.given: a run with retained catalog payloads
gen14_full_cycle_bdds.then: a store-specific pack with collection-backed relationships replaces the generic starter pack, and curation refuses gracefully when payloads are absent
gen14_full_cycle_bdds.evidence: Pink Lily curated pack (8 store-specific queries, promo collections excluded); curated re-inspection ran 8/8 with products. VAL-055.

gen14_full_cycle_bdds.title: Executive reports render as branded, sendable PDFs
gen14_full_cycle_bdds.then: a Northvalley-branded multi-page PDF compiles with an evidence-basis cover, scorecard, findings, and an explicit limitations page
gen14_full_cycle_bdds.evidence: latexmk compile, pdfinfo/pdftotext checks, rendered-page layout review with two defects fixed. VAL-056.

gen14_full_cycle_bdds.title: Rendered capture observes what customers see and compares it to endpoint evidence (P008)
gen14_full_cycle_bdds.then: rendered search pages and visible autocomplete dropdowns are captured with screenshots, and visible-versus-API suggestion counts are recorded per query
gen14_full_cycle_bdds.evidence: Live Pink Lily rendered runs: 5/5 pages with products, 3/5 visible dropdowns via container-fallback extraction, comparison fields verified after the resource-group flattening fix. VAL-057, deterministic rerun in VAL-058.

gen14_full_cycle_bdds.title: Blocked or partial stores degrade honestly in generated reports
gen14_full_cycle_bdds.given: a traffic-regulated store with blocked surfaces
gen14_full_cycle_bdds.then: unobserved surfaces carry no scores or claims, observed surfaces still score, and coverage gaps are stated
gen14_full_cycle_bdds.evidence: Ridge executive report: blocked Search shows not-observed with no score while canonical-host Autocomplete scores; coverage gap stated. VAL-058.
